package main

// Measurement only, not committed. Mirrors the CLI: --source read with
// coderoutes.FromPath, addSpecRequests (local target), then Check with B
// and C.
import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"net/netip"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"github.com/Gobbuwu/SiegeKit/internal/authz"
	"github.com/Gobbuwu/SiegeKit/internal/coderoutes"
	"github.com/Gobbuwu/SiegeKit/internal/egress"
	"github.com/Gobbuwu/SiegeKit/internal/openapi"
	"github.com/Gobbuwu/SiegeKit/internal/target"
)

func TestZZCode(t *testing.T) {
	harPath := os.Getenv("ZZ_HAR")
	if harPath == "" {
		t.Skip()
	}
	data, _ := os.ReadFile(harPath)
	tu, _ := target.Parse(os.Getenv("ZZ_TARGET"))
	h, err := authz.ParseHAR(data, tu)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	harN := len(h.Requests)
	var spec *openapi.Spec
	if sp := os.Getenv("ZZ_SPEC"); sp != "" {
		b, _ := os.ReadFile(sp)
		format, err := openapi.Check(b)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		spec = &openapi.Spec{Data: b, Format: format, Source: sp}
	}
	var code []authz.SpecRoute
	if d := os.Getenv("ZZ_CODE"); d != "" {
		r, err := coderoutes.FromPath(d)
		fmt.Printf("CODE err=%v files=%d routes=%d found=%v unresolved=%d toobig=%d unparsed=%d truncated=%v\n", err, r.Files, len(r.Routes), r.Found, r.Unresolved, r.TooBig, r.Unparsed, r.Truncated)
		code = r.Routes
	}
	var acc authz.Accounts
	if s := os.Getenv("ZZ_B"); s != "" {
		acc.B, _ = authz.ParseSession(s)
	}
	if s := os.Getenv("ZZ_C"); s != "" {
		acc.C, _ = authz.ParseSessionFrom(authz.SessionEnvC, s)
	}
	h.Sessions = []http.Header{acc.B, acc.C}
	inSpec := addSpecRequests(h, spec, code, false)
	fmt.Printf("PARSED har=%d spec=%d sweep=%d codesweep=%d inspec=%d noid=%d url=%d unreadable=%d action=%d over=%d sweepover=%d\n", harN, h.FromSpec, h.FromSweep, h.FromCodeSweep, inSpec, h.SweepNoID, h.SweepURL, h.SweepUnreadable, h.Action, h.OverLimit, h.SweepOverLimit)
	if os.Getenv("ZZ_DRY") != "" {
		for _, r := range h.Requests[harN:] {
			fmt.Println("RPLAN", r.Path)
		}
		return
	}
	cfg := egress.Config{Target: tu, Addrs: []netip.Addr{netip.MustParseAddr("127.0.0.1")}, Version: "measure", ReadOnly: true}
	res, err := authz.Check(context.Background(), cfg, h.Requests, acc, 100)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	cw := res.CWorks()
	for i, r := range res.Replays {
		src := "har"
		if i >= harN {
			src = "sweep"
		}
		short := func(a authz.Answer) string {
			b := string(a.Body)
			if len(b) > 90 {
				b = b[:90]
			}
			return strings.ReplaceAll(b, "\n", " ")
		}
		fmt.Printf("RREPLAY %-5s %s %s A=%d/%d C=%d/%d B=%d/%d N=%d outsider=%v cross=%v bonly=%v Abody=%q Cbody=%q\n", src, r.Method, r.Path, r.A.Status, len(r.A.Body), r.C.Status, len(r.C.Body), r.B.Status, len(r.B.Body), r.None.Status, r.Outsider(), r.CrossAccount(), r.BOnly(cw), short(r.A), short(r.C))
	}
	fmt.Println("RSUMMARY requests", res.Requests, "rate429", res.Rate429, "cworks", cw)
	fmt.Println("RSUMMARYTEXT", res.Summary(h, os.Getenv("ZZ_USER"), authz.Count(res, os.Getenv("ZZ_USER"))))
	for _, f := range authz.Findings(tu.Origin(), res, os.Getenv("ZZ_USER")) {
		fmt.Println("RFINDING", f.RuleID, f.Severity, f.Location.URI)
	}
}
